name: Haga (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Haga town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Haga, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 October 1991; the emblem dates from 27 December 1956.

features.role: Haga town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes
